recommendation.justification: Satellite NDWI (-0.35) shows high crop water stress, and recent precipitation is below the optimal 1000‑2000 mm required for rice. Conduct a visual disease scout each morning for blast, sheath blight, and leaf spot; if symptoms appear, initiate appropriate fungicide treatment per local extension guidelines.
Record irrigation volume, timing, and soil moisture readings in a field log and report to the farm manager by end of day.

Conduct a visual disease scout each morning for blast, sheath blight, and leaf spot; if symptoms appear, initiate appropriate fungicide treatment per local extension guidelines.
Record irrigation volume, timing, and soil moisture readings in a field log and report to the farm manager by end of day.
